review_description: Adelaide Solarsafe visited site and explained how and where the system elements would be installed. They also explained how time of use energy tariffs worked and how to minimise costs.The installation date was confirmed several weeks before and the installers arrived as promised on the agreed date and completed the installation in one day. Being an older home with an extension there were some installation issues which they quickly addressed. The completed installation was very neat and tidy and the site was left clean and tidy.The installation crew were very polite and ensured I had the mySigen App loaded and I understood the basics before they left.As a retired electrical engineer I would certainly recommend Adelaide Solarsafe to anyone considering installing a solar system.

Initial meeting and subsequent discussions regarding the design and installation of a battery for our existing solar system reassured us that we were dealing with an experienced and honest company. We have particular energy needs and SolarSafe took these requirements into account when designing the solution.On the day of the installation the work was done without fuss, The team was punctual, very polite and were all too happy to answer any of our questions. When works had been completed the site was left very clean. The handover process was thorough and conducted at a pace that I found comfortable.All in all we were very happy with the solution and its installation.

The sales person was thorough and professional, as well as informative and responsive to questions. He brought a drone and used it to view the existing solar array on the roof, enabling him to better advise on feasibility of expansion. He also provided detailed, plain English explanations of different options and approaches to battery addition. These included the implications for future household power use and power provider plans to best match battery plus solar option(s). He inspected our property to see where we thought the battery and related system pieces would go and offered his opinions. Those resulted in a couple of minor changes - both for the better.He provided detailed quotations within a week and they clearly had been designed with our specific situation in mind - not based on a template with cut and pasted changes.We were able to get the installation scheduled for our preferred date, which was 2 months away. The installers arrived promptly on the specified morning,  but not too early. They were polite and efficient. We were able to carry on our normal routine with only a short power interruption in the early afternoon (~90 minutes). They gave us plenty of warning and were happy to fit the power cut around our needs.The installation was scheduled to take 2 days but the team were finished in 1 day. Locating battery and system components followed the plan discussed with the salesperson and resulted in an easier installation, according to the leading hand.Once installed, they took us through the app installation and briefed us on its use. That went as well as could be expected and teh app is pretty well designed. I am finding it more accessible and useable than most such tools. They also briefed us on the components of the system and the procedures involved in switching them on and off, isolating parts of the system, etc. They performed a backup test by switching off the grid supply and the battery continued power supply seamlessly. They also tested the AC charger installed for use with our electric vehicle, to determine the maximum charging power available.Overall, our experience has been excellent, from quoting through to installation. We hope our ongoing experience using the system will be similarly excellent.

From the 2 visits Andy did helping us with lots of questions to Ash and his spot on scheduling...it was faultless.  The team of 4 installers worked flat put and kept the property tidy. I am recommending them to my mother in law
The installation went seemlessly and the interruption free change to battery with a mains fail is fantastic

Very knowledgable and everything was easy and courteous. A pleasure to deal with. 6.6kW in 17 Jinko panels, 10 North, 4 West, and 3 East.  It caps out at 5kW limit from about 10:30am through to 4:00pm on clear days during November, and fully covers an electric kettle by 8:30am

Highly detailed and knowledgeable consultation and sale processes, good communication, professional and attentive and high quality installation. Minor issue - we initially agreed on the location of the Gateway but this wasn't communicated internally - they took full responsibility and moved it no questions asked.

Had some great advice from James the salesman on which solar battery to select.The installation went smoothly with the team dead on time!Terrific customer service with good explanations on how system works in layman’s terms.

Andy came out to the house to view the location of the panels and inverter and then provided excellent advice and a comprehensive quote.Install was a breeze, team turned up on time, installed the system exactly as quoted, cleaned up, removed all packaging and explained how to use the system using the app.Had the system for a couple of months now and we are very pleased with the performance. Been able to charge the EV totally from solar since the system was fitted and that is during the winter months.Very much recommend Adelaide Solarsafe for an excellent system and install.

We recently upgraded our aging rooftop solar system to a new SigEnergy Solar (16kw) and Battery (24kw) system with Adelaide Solar Safe.We had reservations about the price and return on investment.  However, now the system is installed, we are very happy with the amount of energy generated, and available to use during peak energy price periods.  We have significantly reduced our reliance on the grid, and now have the capacity to charge a PHEV.The team at Adelaide Solar Safe were very helpful in discussing the installation package recommended for our needs.  The installation team were very communicative in planning installation dates, explaining system details and use, and how to use of the SigEnergy Phone App.The installation was done very efficiently and neatly and the site was left spotless after completion.We are very happy with the entire process and final product.

Sales/quoting process:  I felt this was good and informative. There was a reasonable amount of flexibility as my response was not made within the time limit of the quote.The installers were punctual and polite.  While the possibility of damage to quite a few roof tiles was advised very few were damaged. Finally, there was no post installation mess.I felt the customer service was good,

I recently commissioned a solar system with SolarSafe and was thoroughly impressed by their service. From start to finish, they were polite, informative, and professional. Every question I had was answered clearly and they took the time to explain the details without rushing. Their respectful and knowledgeable approach made the experience smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend them for anyone considering investing in solar panels and batteries.
Very satisfied with Adelaide SolarSafe - very professional and talked me through everything - very happy.

It was a pleasure dealing with SolarSafe, from initially meeting Andy to discuss our requirements to farewelling the installation team from our home.At our first meeting to discuss our requirements, Andy was not only good at providing excellent practical advice, but also very good at listening to my questions and requests. He was quick, but thoughtful in recommending a system to suit our needs and budget along with the practical aspect of limited roof space and location due to local council heritage regulations. The fact that SolarSafe had done previous installations in our suburb gave peace of mind.Come the day of installation, the team arrived at a practical time and all were very courteous. They worked very well and efficiently together. The installation progressed well despite some cavity wall access issues, which were resolved with persistence and without fuss.The team showed great attention to detail, including roof and site clean-up of any mess.Team leader, Laurence gave a clear demonstration and instruction of how the system worked and guided me through installing the app to monitor the system on my mobile phone. Additionally, he advised me of the next steps in contacting our energy retailer to complete the process. All up, the entire installation was completed before midday.Overall, I was very pleased and impressed with the SolarSafe experience.

Quote process was easy to understand. I already had an existing working 5Kw system and wanted extra panels, Inverter upgrade and Battery to 10Kw. Andy explained everything from his many years of solar installations. Installers arrived on time and a pleasure to deal with. They explained where everything would go, and kept me up to date with the total installation. The Inverter, panels and battery were placed exactly where I wanted them while still being within the Regulations requirements. Work was first class and they cleaned up everything. Explained the App update and the blackout procedure with our choice of light and power that would still operate with power shutdown. Couldn't be happier with the whole process. Would recommend this Company to anyone. A1+

Excellent quotes and fair and reasonable with explanationsPolite, Punctual and very tidy through install processShowed me how to read the app with the battery and solar consumption and the grid. was very informative

All participants, starting with the sales chap were great to interact with and their communication was excellent and prompt.The install was delayed by 2 months due to an approval from the CEC taking way too long. Apparently, this affected the whole industry who were wanting to install some SigEnergy products. But when the approval came, the install was commenced within days. It only took 2 days from start to finish. Commissioning was super fast and hassle free.There are some minor questions I have about the system interfacing with my generator but I'm sure they will be addressed fairly quickly. I think Sig will be the ones to help here.The crew who did the install were excellent. So much so, that they even got out the day before they expected to !Worked in a neat and tidy way and were very polite and appeared well committed to the job in hand. Good guys. Many thanks.

Sale quoting process was easy, one visit to look at the property, range of options with a recommended option which we chose.Worked with us with finance and making sure we have the latest system.Professional knowledge and installation to suit our needs.They walked me through every aspect of the system, explained it all, hooked me up with the app and organised the grid connection.

All went very well. I was a bit indecisive choosing what product(s) to use and the team helped me get to a point, where I could make a sensible decision. Everything was handled very well from their point of view, and they listened to any questions I had and were able to answer accordingly. The install was smooth and the ground team were really good to deal with. A very neat and visually appealing install it is :). We are very happy with the overall result.

Exceptional service from a family owned local business. The team cleaned up so well, would not have known they had just installed my new solar system. Dan made sure I knew how to understand my new solar monitoring app, which is a huge step for me as I’m not so good with understanding technology:)Thank you to the team at Adelaide Solarsafe for a wonderful and helpful experience
It was all efficiently and professionally done. Andy was punctual and polite.

I have been very impressed with Adelaide SolarSafe's professionalism, attention to detail and customer focus.  Right from the very start when I contacted Andy (I had been given his number by a friend who too had received great service) through the follow up by Ash after installation I have been very happy with the personal touch and knowledgable support I have received in upgrading my solar system to provide for battery storage for now and well into the future.This ESS will allow me (and particularly my wife) to switch on the washing machine, dishwasher, oven outside of the solar sponge/shoulder period without worrying about a horrendous electricity bill at the end of the month - and it is all coming from green energy!

Andy was fantastic to deal with upfront, reviewing our power needs and recommending the most optimal system for our home.On the day of installation, the installers were all polite and did a great job. Did a great job cleaning up also.I have had dealings post install with Andy and Ash in assisting me upgrading our meter to a smart meter with Origin. Have been a delight throughout the whole process.
Andrew was excellent, answered all questions and went through everything in great detail.Crew doing the install showed up on time, cleaned up and did a fantastic job.

So good to have a small family business who isn’t trying to sell us anything, but rather giving tailored recommendations, advice and great customer service. They delivered exactly what they said in a timely manner and we would very highly recommend

Andy took the time to explain many facets of how I use my electricity to save money, future proofing by investing now to save money as electricity bills are only going to increase. The team of installers were polite, on time, provided additional advice and cleaned up after themselves. We chose to install not just a Solar Battery but a Solar Water Pump as well. I know from previously having them install our panels that after sales service is just as reliable.

The entire experience is with Adelaide SolarSafe was professional and helpful, right down to details about the best fixings for my roof. Small details like an actual roof inspection rather than google provide confidence. Mine was a relatively small and straight forward installation but the team treated me and the work with the same as attention to detail I would expect of larger jobs. The installation was professionally managed, tidy and respectful, and they answered any question I had. Highly recommended.

EXCELLENT company. Good price. Good options. Flexible. Really nice people all round from Andy with the quote to Jonathon in admin to Kyan and Ryan the installers. Seems to be running very efficiently.I think that they designed the best system for my roof and my circumstances.

Professional approach by Andy taking time to ask me what my needs were, listening and advising accordingly. He was competitive in pricing and his team installed the battery ahead of schedule, going out of his way to meet my needs. The team also uninstalled the existing failed LG system as part of their service. At no charge, Andy additionally provided a drone review with pictures of my solar panels to ensure all was healthy on the roof.

Installers were good, quick and clean, with the work place left clean.   Very professional right through.The solaredge system works well,  however it is not mentioned that there is zero accessibility to inverter function as a system owner. It isn't possible to load shift, and as an owner you are not given admin access to the system.No regrets about Adelaide Solar Safe,  would use them again,  but in hindsight,  would not recommend Solaredge unless you are happy with bare functionality and no ability to control your system.

Initial consult was friendly and informative, assessing my energy usage.Installation on day scheduled, polite trades.Disappointed that installers left heaps of scrap (wire, metal parts, screws) on the roof and in gutter. Reported it and it was dealt with appropriately some days after and got apology.Happy with the app to monitor system.

Andy Turner provided a very good quotation and explained ways for us to maximise the benefits of having a solar system. His workers did an excellent job of installing a high quality system, they were helpful and polite, they cleaned up well after the job and the electrician took the time to help us install and understand the monitoring app. No hesitation in recommending Adelaide SolarSafe to others considering the switch to solar power. Andrew and Carol from Torrensville.
The fourth property Adelaide Solarsafe has been involved in for our family - lots of trust of Andy and his team
Professional and detailed quoting process.Polite well-mannered installersHelpful with the setup procedure

Sales were informative & happy to answer all questions over a few week period, without being pushy.It was not the cheapest, but seemed comparable to other quotes received for similar quality.Once I signed up, installation proceeded quickly on date advised.Installers were punctual, very polite & left the area clean & tidy.All paperwork was completed for us, including grid connection & advice given re the solar app.  This was super easy to have up & running & love that we can see what is being generated v output etc.Would be happy to recommend Adelaide Solarsafe at this early stage!

Andy attended on time to inspect and quote.He was thorough and took time to understand our site and requirements.Explanations of the options were clear, with an ability to dig in deeper where I wanted to.The installation team arrived on time, were well presented, took time to introduce themselves and worked in an organised manner. The installation was performed to a high standard, respectful of the property (1920's bungalow) and the site was left clean and tidy (i.e. no packaging, no offcuts, no drilling dust etc.)All documentation was completed and submitted.I think you would struggle to find anyone who could perform the job better. Worth every penny in my opinion.
Quote completed quickly, installation arranged in time to receive Tesla rebate, despite it being Christmas. Very efficient service.

Detailed sales and quotation process, polite, punctual and complete in 1 day rather than 2.  System was working when they left, All I had to do was install a smart meter and get system reset. Only issue was flexible export was too low but that was a SAPN problem. A dedicated Adelaide Solarsafe resource was available to sort or assist with any post install issues
Andy from Solarsafe was excellent in describing the system and how power is used during the day. Cannot complain how everything went.

The whole process was easy. I had originally contacted Adelaide Solar safe to get a quote on a replacement inverter as the original had died. I made Andy aware that I was considering a second solar system and a battery but was still thinking about this option.Andy arrived at our property at the time we had arranged, he reviewed our existing solar installation and went through replacement inverter options and suggested what would be the best. To extend our current system and add a battery Andy reviewed our current usage, the roof space available and where a battery could be fitted. He provided quotes for just a replacement inverter and a quote for an additional system which were detailed and easy to understand. He promptly replied to any questions I had and this made for an easy decision to accept both quotes.The installation team were excellent and had the replacement inverter and the additional solar system and battery installed within a day. The installation is very neat and everything is well laid out, his installers helped me to connect to the monitoring systems and also took me through the shut down and start up procedures. When they had finished the installation the site was cleaned all rubbish removed.I would be happy to recommend Adelaide Solar Safe to others considering solar and or batteries.

The sales quote was done on the same day as Andy visited to look at our house for the quote.The installation was great and the people who did it were polite, punctual, respectful and tidy. The install took 1 1/2 days and the guys worked tirelessly to get the roof done the first day as the rain was coming.Customer service has been fis=rst rate.

My entire experience with Adelaide SolarSafe exceeded expectations. I had done my research to the point of being overwhelmed.. I was receiving conflicting information from various companies. Andy from Adelaide SolarSafe explained the product and process in an easily understood way (without mansplaining). We were given several options and prices ranges, with an explanation on performance and ability for for adding a battery or more panels in the future. We selected REC panels and SolarEdge inverter. The quotes were received in the promised timeframe.The installation occurred earlier than promised (which was great), about two weeks after receiving the quote. John and his men arrived early to start the job, advising that it would most likely take the full day to complete. With very minimal fuss and impact to our household, all works were completed by 2pm! We now are able to monitor our power generation and usage, and make decisions about power use to reduce drawing from the grid.I would highly recommend Andy, John and the staff at Adelaide SolarSafe.
Customer service was very  friendly  and informative.  Gave a start time and stuck  to it. Value was there from the set up we wanted.

Quoting process was very well explained, and the dismantling and removal of all the old system was very well done, with no mess left behind. All the different trades people were punctual, and polite, and when it was all complete, they organized the grid connection.
The sales/quotation process was smooth.Installation was bought forward and completed within the time schedule.Customer service has been great. No questions have been off limits.

The sales and quoting process went well and we could have easily gone with any of the 3 quotes with confidence.The team that did the installation were punctual, friendly, efficient and willing to patiently explain any details when asked.The grid connection (after 2 days) appears seamless and was organised by the company.

We decided to go with SolarSafe and a SolarEdge system for a number of reasons; Andy came on a site visit and spent quite a while with us going over our current usage and future usage requirements prior to providing a quote, Provided a system that could extend our self consumption rather than focusing on max panels during the most productive times of the day only to either export most of it for pennies and be export limited, Single vendor solution with a solid reputation and warranties on all components (that can be extended), Monitoring capabilities are an order of magnitude better than that of other vendors and reassuring that the installer is able to be alerted to and act upon issues should something arise, Family owned business with in house installers.The installers did a great job, were on time, friendly, and unobtrusive which was nice considering we both work from home. They left the place spotless as well.It wasn't the cheapest solution on up front cost from the quotes we received but wasn't far off and I feel confident that we have made the right decision with SolarSafe.

The sales person was knowledgeable and explained the options clearlyThe quotation was quickly sent to me within 24 hours and was exactly as discussedThe installation team was punctual and set about their tasks with precision and courtesyGrid connection was arranged once the quote was accepted and deposit paidI can highly recommend Adelaide Solar Safe to anyone considering “going solar”
The company representative/owner attended our home, answered questions gave us options, viewed possible installation sites, spoke about the electrical meter change and gave solid advice.

I was impressed with the quotation process. Andy provided a personal service by meeting me on site. He explained everything in a way that was easy to understand and provided options. His quote came to me when promised and was competitive with other quotes.Once I had excepted the quote the communication process about what happens next, and when, was great. John was always happy to help me with any questions regarding installation and kept me updated.Dan and his team of installers arrived on time and completed the work quickly and neatly. They were polite and explained what was happening.Finally the after sales and installation has been very impressive. John and Andy have both provided good after sales advice and are always happy to help with any questions that arise.Overall this has been an excellent experience.

Andy from Adelaide SolarSafe was very friendly on the phone, and offered to come in-house to review my setup knowing I had an older 1960s home. He reviewed my meter box and raised some concerns (which he later followed up on and advised would not be an issue). Andy even flew a little drone around my roof space to photograph the site prior to installation which allowed him to see and identify that the proposed flat roof would require special clamps in order to secure the solar panels. When on site Andy talked through a lot of variables that could impact the quote (such as size of system, panel direction, inverter types, future plans for EV or battery, etc), he also was the only installer to talk about the requirements of flexible exports imposed by SA Power Networks.No other installers had visited my house and relied only on satellite view in order to put together their quotes, I really appreciate the extra effort Andy went to.The installers were early on the installation day, and were very quick to complete the job. They even organised contacting my energy provider in order to get my older power meter upgraded to a smart meter.I had some issues post installation with the consumption monitoring elements of the inverters online portal, and the installer came back the following day to resolve all the issues.In all, I couldn't be more happier with the team or the job, and would highly recommend their services.

Andy provided a very detailed quote on site, assessed the house with his drone, looked at my electricity consumption and designed a quote within my price range. He explained the solar system which would best suit my needs and was very happy to answer any questions regarding the solar quote. I would recommend Andy and his team at Adelaide SolarSafe for anyone looking at getting a new or replacement solar system for their property.The installation team were also very efficient, the site was left spotless and they went through the SMA monitoring application.  Unfortunately the installers put the NW panels portrait instead of the quoted landscape layout. Despite this mistake, the performance of the system has not been affected by the different layout and is producing the predicted KW's.

Andy came to our home to assess the dimensions of our roof using a drone to take photos so that he could work out how many panels would be required, Andy then explained to us the options available in deciding which panels would be best for us. That afternoon a photo of the roof with panels in situ and a quote were sent by email. No pressure at all quote acceptedAndy's team of young men who did the installation were professional, punctual very polite and there was no litter left behind once finishedA team member organised with my electricity provider to connect us to the grid, all went smoothly.I would recommend this company to anyone wanting to install Solar panels
Great customer service and friendly installer, very helpful and neat and tidy

Fast response to my initial enquiry. Arrived when they said they would. Inspected roof and site. Very knowledgeable and offered several options, patiently explained the pros and cons of each. Once quote accepted they staying in touch with updates on the process and install steps. Installers were very polite, arrived when they said. Work area all cleaned after completion.

Andy and his family at Adelaide solarsafe were absolutely fantastic.He took the time to come out to our house, go through all our options and explain the differences between different systems.He also gave us tips for optimising our energy use and ideas on how to negotiate with our electricity retailer to get the best feed in tariffs and buy from grid rates. They weren’t the cheapest or most expensive but you definitely get what you pay for with this company!The boys on install were professional, fast and did a super clean / efficient job. We are really happy with our system and would recommend these guys to anybody who asks.

Adelaide SolarSafe were fantastic from day one and we are really pleased with the final products and the installation.We would highly recommend them to anyone. Their expertise, knowledge and client service was absolutely first class, and they did all of the paperwork for the grid connection - brilliant!

Andy did a fantastic job during the site visit. He took pictures of the roof with a drone and took into consideration our requirements. His office was a great help with the battery rebate application and all the other paperwork. Installation was without any problem. So far the system runs great. But it is definitely early days.

Small family run business. I spoke to Andy, who talked through the system that they would use. Whilst not the cheapest system, due to the information provided by Solar Quotes, I was able to see that the system was a good one for the price, which was only slightly higher than another quoter.Andy informed us of the likely timeframe but was able to install the panels earlier than expected. The team were punctual and tidy and went through everything.Everything was organised for us and we really didn't have to do anything other than install the app to have a look at what our system is doing.Great overall service and I am very happy with the system.

I was confident in making my decisions as the salesperson clearly provided information  and explanations and ensured I understood things. Quote was detailed and informative and provided promptly.Installation was done competently and installers were polite, respectful, kept me informed and answered my questions.They were on time, cleaned up on finishing the installation.The installer has organised the grid connection, will assist me to install the monitoring app and ensure I understand how to interpret the information and, provide future support as required.

Sales quoting process detailed and professional follow up and installation excellent.. Installation contractors polite quick and tidy. Solar Safe arranged all necessary activity regarding grid connection.
Great service on all accounts from the initial catch up right through to installation and post job. Great attention to detail, definitely know their craft and product.  Highly recommended.

Using the SolarQuotes website, I carefully selected three solar installers to quote on my proposed BESS, all of whom had experience with the brands of inverters and battery that I wanted. I received the three quotes and all of them seemed reasonable. However, I selected Adelaide SolarSafe because the owner of this family business, Andy, had spent quite a bit of time with me on site and offered a number of helpful suggestions and value adds. Andy subsequently gave detailed answers to the various questions from me that followed receipt of his quote. I therefore felt very comfortable in accepting his quote and was glad that I did so. The installation went very well. There were no unpleasant surprises and the quality of the installation and subsequent clean-up was very high by Ash (Andy's son) and his team, who were all polite, tidy and punctual. I certainly have no hesitation in commending Adelaide SolarSafe to others who want to have a solar system installed.

Apart from some delays due to having to get roof re-roofed and weather, everything was nice and simple and straight forward. Regular communication and worked with the other tradies as required with no issues.

Andy and the team at Adelaide SolarSafe were very easy to deal with, the communication from before the quote/site visit was excellent. Although they were the highest quote we received, Andy's knowledge and expertise proved far more valuable in designing a highly efficient system.Having a person come out on site before quoting was a breath of fresh air, and in the end saved us a lot of hassle that other desktop designs we were quoted would have caused.We were slotted in 1 week after quoting due to a cancellation, which was a pleasant surprise. We had some complications with some miscommunication in the install, but the team owned their mistakes and solved all the problems without too much of a hassle.Overall it was worth paying a bit more, to have a super productove system up 1 week after receiving a quote.
Adelaide SolarSafe were prompt and professional from the start of our process. We changed our preferred solution during our evaluation.From order to install we had a seamless experience.
From the quote to install and price this company offers the very best value for money with quality products and professionalism and a high standard of customer service.  Would highly recommend!!

I liked that Solar Safe didn't quote until they came out. The other two just emailed me quotes straight away. Whilst I appreciated their quick service, I'm not someone that always goes for the cheapest quote. I want information and options, which I got from Adelaide Solar Safe.I was happy with the price for what I chose. I like the structure of the company. Andy the owner has his son Brett in the office, I could email or call any time and get an answer straight away.Installation was last week, they were on time and did a great job and cleaned up after themselves. I got a call in the afternoon from Brett checking I was happy and di the boys clean up after themselves.I do have an issue, now reliant on SA Power Networks to fix so my Solar is currently switched off. Brett said he would ring me tomorrow after he has spoken to a contact at Vector.It is all working and set up, just not safe to turn in due to an old switch that needs removing. I live in a unit and everyone's power has to be turned off so only SA Power Networks can do that apparently.

Adelaide Solar Safe not only provided me with the best quote, they were not pushy and allowed me time to review everything before choosing them. Once I made my decision they were very quick to get started and the installation was done very quickly. Everyone from Sales, Admin and Install were very friendly, professional and happy to answer any question. I would highly recommend Adelaide Solar Safe to anyone wanting to get solar installed.

Just had installed our third system for family members by Adelaide SolarSafe. A family and local company who we trust with competitive pricing, installation and being there if required after the sale and installation

Sales person was very professional and completed a comprehensive inspection of our property compared to other solar companies.Installation was a breeze! The installers were very polite/tidy and professional.Would recommend  Adelaide Solar Safe to anyone looking to install a solar system.

From start to finish the attention I received was of the highest quality. Andy was very patient and answered all my questions, took plenty of time to explain his design to me throughout the quoting process. I never felt rushed or pressured by Andy to choose his quote. The installation itself was done by Andy's son, Ash. Ash was polite, as were his team on installation day. They tidied up well and the whole process felt extremely efficient. Communication was fantastic throughout. I get the impression the system was at the higher end of the price range, however I am confident I got a good quality system and installation. The service was so good that any extra cost was well accounted for. Would recommend solar safe to anybody.
Professional and easy to understand concepts, kept me up to date during installation on what was happening and then talked me through the relevant apps that worked with the system

Our neighbours initially had there solar installed by Adelaide SolarSafe and were extremely happy with the service they received, so hence after a few quotes we felt very reassured that we also would be happy with the service and they delivered in every way. So thank you to Adelaide SolarSafe

I reecieved prompt and informed service where Andy Turner made time in his busy schedule to come out to m y home & go through the many options I could use.He gave the benefits & costs from a cheap system to a more expensive higher quality system.

It was great to deal with Adelaide Solar Safe. As someone who knew little about solar systems, I found Andy not only extremely well prepared, but also patient in answering all the questions I asked him even if probably some of them were really silly.It wasn’t necessarily the cheapest quote I received, but they gave me confidence they were doing the right thing.The system was installed approximately 5-6 weeks after I signed the contract, and they took care of every step of the process particularly on the administrative side (i.e. helping us switching energy providers, getting the rebates, etc.)The installing team was superb. It took them 3 days to install everything and get the system up and running, but they didn’t cut any corners, and they didn’t leave any dirt or rubbish behind.Highly recommended!
All I had to do was let the team in. Everything was done seamlessly and tidily.Old fashioned service that always is a winner.

If you are considering solar paneIs for your home, I highly recommend Adelaide solar safe. I found the process to be very easy and stress free. They took care of everything and the installers on site were punctual, courteous and provided an exceptional quality of workmanship. I now look forward to checking the app every day to see how much power my panels are generating. If you need solar panels don't hesitate to call adelaide solar safe.

Quoting process was personalised to what is important to me, technical issues explained, friendly follow up.  Installed sooner than predicted and the guys were on time, worked hard all day, left everything clean and tidy, showed me how the system worked. Good follow up and checked if I was happy with service. Installer arranged SEG and grid connection with my retailer.

Andy fitted us in when he was booked out as I was leaving within a couple of days. He was honest and upfront. I love that he told me they wouldn't be the cheapest but would use quality materials and installers. This is a mantra that I used when in business myself in a small business.
